setup: You are [[op_ing]] $\frac{[[b]]}{[[den]]}$ from $\frac{[[a]]}{[[den]]}$. The bottoms already match.

steps.say: Same bottoms means you subtract the numerators directly: [[a]] − [[b]] = [[raw_num]].
The denominator [[den]] stays as it is, for the same reason it did when adding: the size of one whole has not changed.
